study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain charts for the human lifespan

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized additive models for location, scale and shape (GAMLSS) were used to estimate non-linear age-related trends (median and variance).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We created brain charts for the human lifespan using generalized additive models for location, scale and shape (GAMLSS), a robust and flexible framework for modelling non-linear growth trajectories recommended by the World Health Organization.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Article / Mapping normative brain growth / Paragraph 1

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Total cortical grey matter volume (GMV), total white matter volume (WMV), total subcortical grey matter volume (sGMV), total ventricular cerebrospinal fluid volume (CSF), total cerebrum volume (TCV, treated here as GBV), mean cortical thickness, total surface area, and regional cortical volumes.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: GAMLSS models were fitted to structural MRI data from control subjects for the four main tissue volumes of the cerebrum (total cortical grey matter volume (GMV), total white matter volume (WMV), total subcortical grey matter volume (sGMV) and total ventricular cerebrospinal fluid volume (ventricles or CSF)). ... estimate normative trajectories for additional MRI phenotypes including other morphometric properties at a global scale (mean cortical thickness and total surface area) and regional volume at each of 34 cortical areas
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Article / Mapping normative brain growth / Paragraph 2; Article / Extended neuroimaging phenotypes / Paragraph 1

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age (modelled with fractional polynomials), Sex, Study (random effect), and Preprocessing software version (fixed effect).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: using a sex-stratified approach, age, preprocessing pipeline and study were each included in the GAMLSS model estimation... using fractional polynomials to model nonlinear trends.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Article / Model generation and specification / Paragraph 3
